highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 with a broad managed-layer performance sprint and .NET 11 WASM support.
highlights_body: Multiple allocation-free and zero-copy optimizations land across SKColor, SKPMColor, HarfBuzzSharp, and SKShaper. Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries bring .NET 11 WASM support with the new exnref exception-handling model. No breaking changes in this release.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, including multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges and a CPU raster regression fix (restored SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT).

bullets.lead: SKColor and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed integer math
bullets.detail: SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed code without P/Invoke, eliminating round-trip overhead on hot color paths.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: The hex-color parser is rewritten for speed and gains new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in string-heavy color parsing workflows.

bullets.lead: SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans
bullets.detail: Glyph output arrays are now consumed through zero-copy spans instead of marshalled copies, reducing allocation and native-boundary traffic in shaping-heavy workloads.

bullets.lead: SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocates per call
bullets.detail: The per-call char[4] allocation in SKFourByteTag.Parse is eliminated, benefiting consumers that parse many font tags (feature lists, codec options) in a loop.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)
bullets.detail: When a region-cropped decode failed, the native image was not released. The fix closes the leak for all failure paths in the SKData + SKRectI overload.
Pre-built native libraries for Emscripten 5.0.6 (with the new exnref exception-handling model required by .NET 11) are shipped, enabling SkiaSharp on .NET 11 preview WASM targets.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Initial Skia m151 submodule bump, Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11, and the cross-backend golden-image visual regression test harness.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the initial Skia m151 submodule and cgmanifest update.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the performance sprint: allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp Tag.Parse and AddUtf8, zero-copy SKShaper glyph spans, SKColor hex-parse optimization with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, elimination of SKFourByteTag per-call allocation, and further m151 upstream stability fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 shipped Emscripten 5.0.6 / .NET 11 WASM support (with exnref exception handling), ported SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor operations to managed integer math, fixed a CPU raster regression from a shader-context removal, and patched a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships two allocation-free performance improvements: AddUtf8(string) uses a pooled UTF-8 encoder to avoid per-call heap allocation, and Tag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] on each call. WASM builds gain Emscripten 5.0.6 support.
